leakage_check.policy: train evidence files must not overlap extracted official eval evidence files

limitations: Stage 1 QA examples are deterministic AST/docstring bootstrap examples for smoke-test training and loader integration; publication-quality synthetic QA still requires the team's chosen generator and filtering pass.
Official SWE-QA-Pro rows do not provide structured evidence files, so evidence files are extracted from answer text and may under-approximate true evidence.
Stage 2 teacher logits/hidden/cache cannot be materialized until target LoRA adapters are trained and the training owner confirms the required DFlash cache format.
